source_clause: ICE14.) EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST has on/ off state. EXTERIOR REAR-VIEWMIRROR DEFROST is independent of any other climate functions.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.15（ICE14）以兩句定出對外後視鏡除霜之 on/off 狀態與其獨立性，兩個 037 leaf 對應之。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 補。**DR #40 於本節獨立判定**（59 §1.1：不以 ch2 側之未決為由停下，亦不以其為由生成）：**ICE14 自身無任何配置限定語**，故不補配置式 PC —— 此與 `2.15` 之 `021-01`／`021-02` 結論相同，**而其依據為本節自身之條文，非承襲 ch2 側之處置**。為什麼這樣切：`121-02`（獨立性）之驗證需兩個不同干擾源（AUTO、climate off），因「獨立」之否證只需一個反例。刻意略過：**DR #40 之不對稱於 ch16 側更明顯** —— `16.9`（ICE8）**連引用鏡面除霜都沒有**（C8 尚有「if this feature available」一句），故 ch16 側之語料對該配置**零陳述**；此實測已補入上繳 39 §5。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第九軸「EMEA ICS 車型」之值（介面型，R-C34）
distinguishing_axis.delta: `2.15` 取**非 ICS** 值，`16.15` 取 **ICS** 值。**兩節之 TC 三欄逐字相同**（`021-01`≡`121-01`、`021-02`≡`121-02`），差異僅在 `pre_conditions` 之軸值，故 `duplicate_of` 不填而以軸值區辨。**本對是全corpus 中唯一兩側 leaf 數相等且逐條等價者**，故其「兩份 TC 是否應合併為一份並以軸值參數化」之問題最為赤裸 —— 已隨 037 分解案登 DR #38

interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文

tcs.tc_title: Exterior mirror defrost has an on and off state
tcs.test_item:
ICE14.) EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST has on/ off state.

(turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost off)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost on
2. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost off
tcs.expected_result:
1. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is on
2. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is off
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST shall have an on/off state

tcs.tc_title: Exterior mirror defrost is independent of the other climate functions
tcs.test_item:
EXTERIOR REAR-VIEWMIRROR DEFROST is independent of any other climate functions.

(turn the climate system off and read the exterior rear-view mirror defrost state)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the exterior rear-view mirror defrost on
2. Turn AUTO on and read the exterior rear-view mirror defrost state
3. Turn the climate system off and read the exterior rear-view mirror defrost state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is on
2. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is still on
3. The exterior rear-view mirror defrost is still on
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: EXTERIOR REAR-VIEW MIRROR DEFROST shall be independent of any other climate functions
